## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 2-juan Yuán-period agricultural manual by Lǔ Míngshàn, the Uyghur Yuán official, composed at Ānfēnglù during his magistracy in *Yányòu* 1 (1314). The work organises the agricultural year by lunar month, providing for each month the appropriate agricultural-and-sericultural tasks. The frontmatter brackets to 1314–1330.

**Abstract**

The *Nóngsāng yīshí cuō yào* is one of two principal Yuán-period agricultural manuals (with the *Nóngsāng jí yào*, [KR3d0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3d/KR3d0003)). The work is methodologically distinguished by its *yuèlìng* (monthly-ordinance) format. The bibliographic record: *Yuán shǐ yìwén zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Nóngjiā lèi*.
